# Architect

> An architecture linter for Next.js App Router projects written in TypeScript. 11 deterministic rules, no model call, exit 1 on a violation.

Architect answers one question other tools do not: given this stack's blueprint,
is this file in the layer it belongs to? Next.js App Router + TypeScript only.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://architect-cli.vercel.app/docs): what Architect is, why it exists, and its non-goals
- [Commands](https://architect-cli.vercel.app/docs/commands): check, init, verify, their flags and exit codes
- [Rules](https://architect-cli.vercel.app/docs/skills): all 11 checked rules and the detect: schema
- [Integrations](https://architect-cli.vercel.app/docs/integrations): GitHub Actions and the Claude Code Stop hook
- [Contributing](https://architect-cli.vercel.app/docs/contributing): how to add a rule with a detect: block

## Commands

- [check](https://architect-cli.vercel.app/docs/commands): Check a project against its stack blueprint
- [init](https://architect-cli.vercel.app/docs/commands): Install the Claude Code skills for this project
- [verify](https://architect-cli.vercel.app/docs/commands): Fail if the violation count rose against the recorded baseline

## Rules

- `use_client_everywhere` (warning): The 'use client' directive is placed at the top of layout, page, or large wrapper components rather than pushed down to only the leaf components that actually need browser interactivity.
- `client_data_fetching_by_default` (warning): Data fetching is moved to client components using useEffect/useState without a user interaction requirement.
- `direct_db_in_page` (critical): Database queries or external API calls are made directly inside page.tsx or layout.tsx files instead of being encapsulated in lib/.
- `server_action_throws` (warning): Server Actions throw errors instead of returning typed result objects.
- `leaked_server_secret` (critical): Importing a module that reads process.env secrets (database URL, API keys) inside a Client Component or a file without 'server-only' guard.
- `scattered_process_env` (warning): process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_* and process.env.DATABASE_URL read directly in lib/ functions, Server Actions, and components.
- `direct_db_in_route` (critical): Database queries or ORM calls are made directly inside API route handlers (route.ts) instead of delegating to service/lib functions.
- `alert_for_errors` (warning): Using window.alert() or alert() to display errors to the user.
- `oversized_extraction` (warning): A component or module was extracted from a page to a separate file, but the extracted file is still 300+ LOC.
- `illegal_import` (critical): A file in components/ imports from app/.
- `missing_layer` (warning): A required directory from the blueprint does not exist.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Levironexe/architect): source, issues and the stack blueprint
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@levironexe/architect): `npx @levironexe/architect check .`
- [Full reference](https://architect-cli.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): install, flags, exit codes, detect: schema
